description.describe_ch: 空間分析實踐是一個快速發展的專業領域，也是空間資料基礎建設之一部分。對空間資訊產業的領先者來說，需要更進一步的建立對於GIS及相關科學的理論與應用技能之理解，提供空間決策及分析論述觀點。本課程作為空間資訊科學理論與應用的進階課程，將透過實作方式協助理解空間資料取得、儲存與分析技術。
description.describe_eh:
Spatial Analysis practice is a rapidly evolving area of expertise and a fundamental component of spatial data infrastructure. As a future practitioner in the spatial information industry, you need to further develop your understanding of theoretical issues and the applied practical skills developed in Geographic Information Systems and Science to provide effective location based and situational intelligence whilst taking advantage of evolving societal and cultural aspects of decision support.
The aim of this unit is to further develop your theoretical knowledge and practical skills in the field of spatial information science. A geographic information system (GIS) environment is utilised to provide for a 'hands-on' approach to facilitate your understanding of, and attainment of the skill-set required for more advanced processes of spatial data acquisition, storage and analysis, and the extraction and presentation of spatial information.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生對於GIS科學之理論知識及實務應用之理解能力
targets.describe_en: Ability to develop students understanding of theoretical knowledge, comprehensive and the applied practical skills developed in Geographic Information Systems and Science.

targets.describe_ch: 建立應用GIS決策支援工具於空間座標及社經課題之分析與設計能力
targets.describe_en: Ability to perform the analysis and design for the creation of a GIS based decision support tool for resolving problems with context issues of spatial location and interaction in social and cultural context.

targets.describe_ch: 針對空間資料之處理、分析、應用及空間資訊模型知識之解讀建立學生討論、解釋及實證能力
targets.describe_en: Ability to discuss, explain and demonstrate the knowledge and practical skills concerning processes of spatial data acquisition, manipulation, compilation, storage and access for spatial analysis, and the extraction and presentation of information for spatial modelling.

textBooks.tpb_book:
1. Spatial Data Analysis (Theory and Practice)
2. Interactive Spatial Data Analysis Pap/Dskt Edition
by Trevor C. Bailey (Author), Anthony C. Gatrell (Author)
3. An Introduction to R for Spatial Analysis and Mapping 1st Edition
by Chris Brunsdon (Author), Lex Comber (Author)
textBooks.tpb_book_en: Spatial Data Analysis (Theory and Practice), first published in 2003, provides a broad ranging treatment of the field of spatial data analysis. It begins with an overview of spatial data analysis and the importance of location (place, context and space) in scientific and policy related research. Covering fundamental problems concerning how attributes in geographical space are represented to the latest methods of exploratory spatial data analysis and spatial modeling, it is designed to take the reader through the key areas that underpin the analysis of spatial data, providing a platform from which to view and critically appreciate many of the key areas of the field. Parts of the text are accessible to undergraduate and master's level students, but it also contains sufficient challenging material that it will be of interest to geographers, social and economic scientists, environmental scientists and statisticians, whose research takes them into the area of spatial analysis.

iSoftwares.soft_memo:
What ArcGIS is a geographical information system (GIS) software that allows handling and analyzing geographic information by visualizing geographical statistics through layer building maps like climate data or trade flows.
QGIS (Quantum Geographic Information System) is a free, open-source software that allows users to create, edit, visualize, analyze, and publish geospatial information. There are many benefits to using QGIS
iSoftwares.soft_memo_en:
What ArcGIS is a geographical information system (GIS) software that allows handling and analyzing geographic information by visualizing geographical statistics through layer building maps like climate data or trade flows.
QGIS (Quantum Geographic Information System) is a free, open-source software that allows users to create, edit, visualize, analyze, and publish geospatial information. There are many benefits to using QGIS
Student will have a chance to use both type of software to practice in this course.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 手機靜音，僅限課堂用途。課堂期間不得使用社交媒體。保持課堂專注，不得閒聊。保持教室整潔，勿亂丟垃圾。禁止在課堂吃食物。請勿在課堂打瞌睡。遵守考試規定，不得相互交流答案。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
This course is physical class, request all students need to show up.
Attending class and working team will be counted for 30%.
Midterm Exam counted 40% and final exam counted for 40%. Both mid-term and final exam are Oral presentation.
The class will be divided into small group and need to finish the mission together.
This course will be taught in english, all presentations need to me show in english version.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
提交的所有學術作業和報告必須是原創的，引用他人資料必須正確標註來源。
鼓勵學術討論，但要保持獨立思考和尊重不同觀點。
在合作研究中，需明確說明各自貢獻，並尊重共同作者。
在考試中，不得幫助他人作弊或接受他人幫助。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: All submitted academic assignments and reports must be original, and citations of others' materials must be properly attributed. Academic discussion is encouraged, but independent thinking and respect for different viewpoints must be maintained. In collaborative research, each person's contribution must be clearly stated, and co-authors must be respected. During examinations, assisting others in cheating or accepting assistance from others is strictly prohibited.
